name: og-autocatalysis-a2
title: Endogenous Autocatalysis (A2): Formose and Reductive-TCA Routes
concept: Can vent-fed chemistry spontaneously form a balanced, self-amplifying autocatalytic cycle that beats a matched null with equal input fluxes — one concept (Gate-A keystone A2), studied at the two representable routes as arms: rule-generated linear-C6 formose chemistry, and the curated branched reductive-TCA cycle.
gate_reason: Gate A2 (endogenous autocatalysis), OFF-SPINE. Consolidates the campaign's two autocatalysis tests into one concept with explicit arms, each judged against its OWN matched null with input fluxes held equal: the rule-generated formose arm (og-29, plan 29, the keystone) and the curated branched reductive-TCA arm (og-rtca, branched v2). BOTH representable routes are refuted under vent conditions, with mechanism — so the consolidated A2 verdict is REFUTED (an honest negative), the keystone of the campaign's honest-negative record. A2 is off-spine and its refuted verdict MUST NOT gate B/C/D: carbon fixation at vent conditions is network PERSISTENCE (A1), not self-amplification (A2). Each arm keeps its own verdict and matched null (see arms).
claim: Both tested routes fail under modeled vent conditions — endogenous self-amplifying autocatalysis is refuted across both representable routes, each against its own matched null. This is a limitation of the modeled vent redox environment, NOT a universal impossibility (see the beyond-vent counterfactual below). The linear-C6 formose arm (og-29) is thermodynamically refuted and seed-independent: the canonical doubling step (r409, 2 glycolaldehyde <-> threose) runs toward condensation (dG0 -16.4 kJ/mol) at vent feeds, so the splitting direction carries no net flux (gain 0, motifs 0 across x1-x50) and production is feed-driven, not self-amplified. The branched reductive-TCA arm (og-rtca) is autocatalytic in TOPOLOGY (its net turn doubles oxaloacetate with no coefficient-2 reaction, so a coefficient detector reads 0 by construction and a coefficient-free functional discriminator is required), yet washes out under vent H2 because the closing reductive carboxylations (succinate->a-ketoglutarate +18, acetyl->pyruvate +31 kJ/mol) run uphill and too slow against washout — the same reason the biological cycle uses ferredoxin, not H2. In a LABELLED beyond-vent counterfactual (lower carboxylation barrier + lower dilution) the same rTCA topology meets the self-amplification bar and is topology-specific (the matched null stays off), so the vent negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a defect of the cycle's wiring. The counterfactual is explicitly not a vent claim. Headline verdict is bounded by the honest negative of both arms: refuted. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved.
question: Can vent-fed chemistry spontaneously form a balanced, self-amplifying autocatalytic cycle that beats a matched null with equal input fluxes — across the two representable routes (rule-generated linear-C6 formose chemistry, and the curated branched reductive-TCA cycle) — or does it only fix carbon (persistence, A1) without self-amplifying (A2)?
hypothesis: Stoichiometric autocatalysis detection plus kinetic simulation under dilution (formose arm) and a coefficient-free functional discriminator against a degree-preserving matched null (rTCA arm) will reveal whether a self-amplifying cycle exists on either representable route; where it does not, the analysis names the rate-limiting / thermodynamic step rather than tuning a pass. No self-amplification is claimed where an arm does not beat its matched null.
experiment: Assemble the vent-fed networks (og-29: rule-generated from the 27+28 handoff bundles; og-rtca: a curated mechanistic libRoadRunner rTCA universe), detect/grade autocatalysis each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal, and report either genuine self-amplification with its critical dilution or a clean mechanistic negative that names the gap — honestly, without tuning a pass, and keeping each route's verdict and matched null explicit.

arms.concept_role: Foundation / keystone (plan 29): does rule-generated vent-fed chemistry (linear C<=6, formose-type) spontaneously form a balanced autocatalytic cycle whose amplification beats a matched null with equal input fluxes? Realized: refuted with mechanism — the canonical doubling step runs toward condensation at vent conditions, so there is no net autocatalytic flux (gain 0, motifs 0), and production is seed-independent.

Sharpened branched route (v2): does the CURATED reductive-TCA cycle — the branched-C6 route the linear skeleton cannot represent — self-amplify under vent CO2/H2 beyond a degree-preserving matched null? Realized: refuted under vent H2 (reductive carboxylations uphill, washes out), though topology-capable in a LABELLED beyond-vent counterfactual — a redox-environment limitation, not a wiring defect.

findings.statement: Study 29 receives the full 27→29 bundle — H2 + inorganic-carbon flux, pH, T, ionic activities, catalyst state and time-dependent feeds — as typed inputs, verified complete before any network is assembled.
Study 29 receives the full 28→29 bundle — canonical species, balanced stoichiometry, rate forms, parameter bounds and confidence tags — as the reaction set, verified complete.

Stoichiometric detection plus kinetic simulation either exhibit a balanced, mass-conserving autocatalytic cycle with measurable amplification and net carbon fixation, or they do not; the finding reports which, with the amplification factor and net fixation when positive.

Any detected amplification must exceed a matched null (identical chemical input fluxes, autocatalytic topology removed); amplification not separable from the null is reported as feed-driven accumulation, not autocatalysis. This is the Gate A null arm.
The study reports the critical dilution rate above which any self-maintaining cycle collapses — its robustness envelope, not a single operating point.
Carbon, mass and charge close across the kinetic run with the 27 feeds as the only carbon/energy source; no untracked input.

If no genuine autocatalysis is found, the study isolates and names the missing precursor or rate-limiting mechanism — a clean negative is an accepted result that scopes downstream work, not a failure to hide.

Under vent H2 a seeded reductive-TCA cycle washes out across the x1-x50 sweep and does not self-amplify; the closing reductive carboxylations (succinate to alpha-ketoglutarate, +18 kJ/mol; acetyl to pyruvate, +31 kJ/mol) are uphill and too slow against washout, mirroring the real cycle's need for ferredoxin rather than H2.

The cycle is autocatalytic in topology - its net turn (1 oxaloacetate + 4 CO2 + 5 H2 -> 2 oxaloacetate + 3 H2O) doubles the carrier oxaloacetate with no explicit coefficient-2 doubling reaction - so a coefficient detector reads gain 0 by construction and only a coefficient-free functional discriminator can judge it. (Acetate is used as an acetyl-CoA surrogate; fumarate is lumped.)

In a labelled permissive counterfactual that lowers the carboxylation barrier, the rTCA topology meets the self-amplification bar on the coefficient-free discriminator and is topology-specific - a degree-preserving null does not switch on - so the vent-condition negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a limitation of the cycle's wiring. This counterfactual is explicitly beyond-vent and is not a vent claim.

With the formose result, this resolves Gate A's A2 (endogenous autocatalysis) for the branched route - self-amplification is refuted under vent conditions, mechanistically, for both representable routes - and records the topology-capable finding as the basis for a possible stronger-reductant / beyond-vent follow-up, outside current vent scope.

autocatalysis-beats-matched-null.detail: At max_carbons=6 the favorable network ignites at x20 feed (network_connected=1, net_carbon_flux 5.69e-4, carbon-fixing) but autocatalytic_gain=0 and n_autocatalytic_motifs=0; the matched null at x20 has gain=0 and essentially identical flux (5.70e-4). Favorable does NOT beat the degree- preserving matched null. REFUTED for formose-type (linear C<=6).

stoichiometric-autocatalysis-detection.detail: No stoichiometric autocatalytic motif detected at any feed, including the ignited x20 point (n_autocatalytic_motifs=0 throughout). The linear C<=6 formose network fixes carbon but contains no self-amplifying cycle.

negative-result-isolates-gap.detail: Gap isolated and characterized: the linear formose universe (C<=6) has no autocatalytic motif even with an active network; the branched C6 rTCA cycle (citrate/isocitrate) is outside the v1 linear-skeleton representation and is the named v2 follow-up.

Reductive-TCA autocatalysis — refuted at vent, topology-capable beyond it

So the vent negative is a redox / residence-time limitation, not a limitation of the rTCA wiring.
